summary: Implemented the interactive two-player CLI gameplay loop with injectable I/O, preserved help behavior, and added scripted command tests for wins, draw, invalid input, out-of-range input, and occupied-cell recovery.

changed_files.summary: Added run(args, in, out, errOut), delegated main through it, wired stdin/stdout gameplay, recoverable move errors, and final result rendering.
Added scripted CLI tests for help, X win, draw, invalid text recovery, out-of-range recovery, and occupied-cell recovery.
